investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Willowen Software (collaboration SaaS); Platform: AWS ap-northeast-1 (zones ap-northeast-1a/ap-northeast-1c/ap-northeast-1d); network range 10.67.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster willow-prod-apnort (EKS); Streaming: Kafka cluster of three brokers (single log directory each); topic webhooks-events uses replication factor 2 and min.insync.replicas 2; producer webhooks-svc, consumer auth-api; Change management: production changes carry CHG- identifiers.
